references.title: E. F. Ecklund, Jr., On prime divisors of the binomial coefficient, Pacific J. Math. 29 (1969) 267-270
references.note: conjectures that for n > k^2, C(n,k) has a prime factor p <= n/k

references.title: Erdős problem #384
references.note: records only the weaker bound lpf(C(n,k)) << n/k^c as known

summary: This node is the finitely-many form of Ecklund's conjecture (equivalently Selfridge's, with the single exception C(62,6)) in the range n >= k^2: exceptions have bounded k. No proof is known; the best unconditional result bounds the least prime factor of C(n,k) by a constant times n/k^c for some c > 0, which does not reach n/k.
